run_mmpose_test: run MMPose model testing with a config file and checkpoint for evaluation
run_test_with_visualization: run MMPose test with visualization enabled to display prediction results in a window
run_test_with_dump: run MMPose test and dump predictions to a pickle file for offline evaluation
run_test_with_cfg_options: run MMPose test with custom config options to override model settings like backbone depth
run_test_save_metrics: run MMPose test and save metric results to a specified output file
